title: Payoff Channel Schedule and the Per-Diem Window (Trade-In Agreements)
content:
A **Trade-In Agreements** lien payoff travels by overnight check or by wire, depending on the latest recorded payoff quote amount, and the channel sets how far the per-diem window runs.

| Quote amount | Channel | Per-diem window runs through |
|---|---|---|
| Below $15000.00 | Overnight check | The day the check arrives: the send date plus 3 days when the send date is a Friday, the send date plus 1 day on any other day of the week |
| $15000.00 or more | Wire | The send date itself |

The per-diem window is the calendar days after the quote's good-through date through the day it runs to, never fewer than none.

## Boundaries

| Quote amount | Channel |
|---|---|
| $14999.99 | Overnight check |
| $15000.00 | Wire |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; good-through date a Monday)

| Quote amount | Send date | Window runs through | Window days |
|---|---|---|---|
| $9800.00 | Wednesday | Thursday | 3 |
| $9800.00 | Friday | Monday after | 7 |
| $15000.00 | Friday | Friday | 4 |
| $9800.00 | Sunday, the day before the good-through date | Monday | 0 |
